about_short_description.short_description: Safepay specializes in digital payments that are secure as well as helps merchants receive payments faster by enabling online payments.

product.name: Payments
product.description: A platform to accept and optimize payments globally, supporting multiple payment methods and increasing authorization rates.

product.name: Subscriptions
product.description: A service to manage recurring payments, supporting subscription-based business models and automating finance operations.

product.name: Routing (Payment Orchestrator)
product.description: A payment gateway orchestration service that connects multiple payment gateways and routes transactions based on custom rules.

product.name: Quick Links
product.description: A tool to create and share customizable payment links for easy, code-free payment collection across multiple channels.

product.name: Hosted Checkout
product.description: A hosted payment page service that enables merchants to receive payments securely through adaptable links across various communication channels.

product.name: Embedded Checkout
product.description: An integration solution that embeds the payment process directly into merchants' websites or e-commerce platforms for a seamless user experience.
